In most cases set this value to true if you are connecting to port 465. For port 587 or 25 keep it false. (from nodemailer.com/smtp/#authentication)

LabelMetadataOrderOfPrecedenceDescriptio: Higher priority metadata sources will override lower priority metadata sources
LabelMobileRedirectURIsDescription: This is a whitelist of valid redirect URIs for mobile apps. The default one is audiobookshelf://oauth, which you can remove or supplement with additional URIs for third-party app integration. Using an asterisk (*) as the sole entry permits any URI.
LabelNotificationsMaxFailedAttemptsHelp: Notifications are disabled once they fail to send this many times
LabelNotificationsMaxQueueSize: Max queue size for notification events
LabelNotificationsMaxQueueSizeHelp: Events are limited to firing 1 per second. Events will be ignored if the queue is at max size. This prevents notification spamming.
LabelOpenIDAdvancedPermsClaimDescription: Name of the OpenID claim that contains advanced permissions for user actions within the application which will apply to non-admin roles (if configured). If the claim is missing from the response, access to ABS will be denied. If a single option is missing, it will be treated as false. Ensure the identity provider's claim matches the expected structure:
LabelOpenIDClaims: Leave the following options empty to disable advanced group and permissions assignment, automatically assigning 'User' group then.
LabelOpenIDGroupClaimDescription: Name of the OpenID claim that contains a list of the user's groups. Commonly referred to as groups. If configured, the application will automatically assign roles based on the user's group memberships, provided that these groups are named case-insensitively 'admin', 'user', or 'guest' in the claim. The claim should contain a list, and if a user belongs to multiple groups, the application will assign the role corresponding to the highest level of access. If no group matches, access will be denied.
LabelPreventIndexing: Prevent your feed from being indexed by iTunes and Google podcast directories
LabelReadAlongTapToSeek: Tap a sentence to play from there
LabelRemoveAudibleBranding: Remove Audible intro and outro from chapters
LabelSeekIndexShiftChapters: Shift the {0} saved chapters to match the corrected timeline
LabelSeekIndexShiftChaptersHelp: Tick this only if these chapters were set from the files or snapped before this repair.
LabelSettingsAllowIframeHelp: Enabling this will allow embedding the web client in an iframe. It is disabled by default for security reasons.
LabelSettingsAudiobooksOnlyHelp: Enabling this setting will ignore ebook files unless they are inside an audiobook folder in which case they will be set as supplementary ebooks
LabelSettingsAutoTranscribePodcastEpisod: Transcribe new episodes without a transcript
Generate a transcript from the audio of each newly downloaded episode whose feed has no timed transcript. Runs on the transcription server, one episode at a time.
LabelSettingsChromecastSupportHelp: Enabling this will add a cast button to the app toolbar. Use it to play media on your Chromecast devices.
LabelSettingsDownloadPodcastTranscriptsH: Save the transcripts that a podcast's feed links to (podcast:transcript) when an episode is downloaded. Without this they are fetched the first time someone opens them.
LabelSettingsEnableWatcherHelp: Enables the automatic adding/updating of items when file changes are detected. *Requires server restart
LabelSettingsEpubsAllowScriptedContentHe: Allow epub files to execute scripts. It is recommended to keep this setting disabled unless you trust the source of the epub files.
LabelSettingsFindCoversHelp:
If your audiobook does not have an embedded cover or a cover image inside the folder, the scanner will attempt to find a cover.

Note: This will extend scan time
LabelSettingsHideSingleBookSeriesHelp: Series that have a single book will be hidden from the series page and home page shelves.
LabelSettingsLibraryMarkAsFinishedWhen: Mark media item as finished when
LabelSettingsOnlyShowLaterBooksInContinu: Skip earlier books in Continue Series

The Continue Series home page shelf shows the first book not started in series that have at least one book finished and no books in progress. Enabling this setting will continue series from the furthest completed book instead of the first book not started.
LabelSettingsParseSubtitlesHelp:
Extract subtitles from audiobook folder names.

Subtitle must be separated by " - "

i.e. "Book Title - A Subtitle Here" has the subtitle "A Subtitle Here"
LabelSettingsPreferMatchedMetadataHelp: Matched data will override item details when using Quick Match. By default Quick Match will only fill in missing details.
LabelSettingsSkipMatchingBooksWithASIN: Skip matching books that already have an ASIN
LabelSettingsSkipMatchingBooksWithISBN: Skip matching books that already have an ISBN
LabelSettingsSortingIgnorePrefixesHelp: i.e. for prefix "the" book title "The Book Title" would sort as "Book Title, The"
LabelSettingsSquareBookCoversHelp: Prefer to use square covers over standard 1.6:1 book covers
LabelSettingsStoreCoversWithItemHelp: By default covers are stored in /metadata/items, enabling this setting will store covers in your library item folder. Only one file named "cover" will be kept
LabelSettingsStoreMetadataWithItemHelp: By default metadata files are stored in /metadata/items, enabling this setting will store metadata files in your library item folders
LabelShareDownloadableHelp: Allows users with the share link to download a zip file of the library item.

MessageSnapSpeechEarly: The chapter heading is heard well after the proposed start, so the chapter would start too early.
MessageSnapSpeechFinishing: Speech check stopped. Waiting for the last request to finish.
MessageSnapSpeechHeading: The chapter heading is heard right after the proposed start.
MessageSnapSpeechHeardTitle: The narrator says "{heard}" here. Use it as the chapter title instead of "{title}" (the start does not change; nothing is saved until you click Save).
MessageSnapSpeechLate: The chapter heading is heard just before the proposed start, so the chapter would start after its heading.
MessageSnapSpeechNoHeading: The chapter heading was not recognised near the proposed start.
MessageSnapSpeechNotExpected: No heading was heard, which is normal here: front and back matter such as a dedication or credits is often not read out.
MessageSnapSpeechStoppedBusy: The speech check stopped because the server is busy. Try again in a moment.
MessageSnapSummaryHeard: {count, plural, one {# heading heard} other {# headings heard}}
MessageSnapSummaryNote: Flagged: the speech check heard the heading too early, too late or not at all, or the move is not certain. Nothing changes until you apply, and nothing is saved until you click Save.
MessageSnapToAudioDescription: Moves chapter starts onto the nearest pause in the audio. With chapters selected, only those are snapped. You review the changes before they are applied.
